newsitem.title: USA: U.S lead production nudges higher in September.
newsitem.headline: U.S lead production nudges higher in September.

text.p: Lead refiners' production in the United States in September rose to 27,968 short tons, up from 27,234 short tons in August, but below the 33,774 short tons produced in September last year, the American Bureau of Metal Statistics reported.
Production in the first nine months of this year totalled 274,890 short tons compared to 306,275 short tons in the same period last year.
The closure by ASARCO of its Omaha lead refining facility in June has affected U.S. production levels. Some of the company's lead bullion is now refined in Canada and Mexico.
Shipments of metal from plants totalled 30,087 short tons in September, down from 33,517 short tons in August.
Refined lead inventories at own plants and elsewhere were 13,568 short tons in September, down 2,097 short tons from 15,665 short tons in August, and at their lowest level so far this year.
